unlisted_practices: Organizations should initially prioritize patient-reported metrics already in development, such as patient-reported experience measures, to accelerate real-world use of patient-reported measures in diagnostic excellence.

Pair patient-reported measures with AI techniques such as diagnostic wayfinding, which analyzes electronic health record data and metadata to characterize the diagnostic journey, to improve diagnostic performance.
